tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a form-level metadata attribute not represented as a leaf element in the MeF IRS1040 schema's canonical element list.

filing_status.rationale: IndividualReturnFilingStatusCd directly encodes the filing status selected by the taxpayer.

mfs_spouse_name.rationale: SpouseNm at the root level captures the spouse's name, used on MFS returns to identify the spouse.

hoh_qualifying_person.rationale: QualifyingHOHNm holds the name of the qualifying person for Head of Household filing status.

taxpayer_first_name.rationale: Primary taxpayer first name is stored in a PersonName/PersonFirstNm element under a primary taxpayer group not present in this candidate list; no direct match available.

taxpayer_last_name.rationale: Primary taxpayer last name is stored in a PersonName/PersonLastNm element under a primary taxpayer group not present in this candidate list; no direct match available.

taxpayer_ssn.rationale: Primary taxpayer SSN is a top-level element (e.g., PrimarySSN) not included in the supplied candidate list.

spouse_first_name.rationale: Spouse first name would be under a spouse name group element not present in this candidate list.

spouse_last_name.rationale: Spouse last name would be under a spouse name group element not present in this candidate list.

spouse_ssn.rationale: Spouse SSN (e.g., SpouseSSN) is not included in the supplied candidate list.

home_address.rationale: Home address street line is stored in an AddressLine1Txt element under a USAddress group not present in this candidate list.

city_state_zip.rationale: City, state, and ZIP are split across CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd elements not present in this candidate list; blueprint bundles them into one string which would need to be split into three separate fields.

foreign_country.rationale: Foreign country name is stored in a ForeignAddress/CountryCd element not present in this candidate list.

foreign_province_state.rationale: Foreign province/state is stored in a ForeignAddress/ProvinceOrStateNm element not present in this candidate list.

foreign_postal_code.rationale: Foreign postal code is stored in a ForeignAddress/ForeignPostalCd element not present in this candidate list.

presidential_election_fund_taxpayer.rationale: PECFPrimaryInd is the Presidential Election Campaign Fund indicator for the primary taxpayer.

presidential_election_fund_spouse.rationale: PECFSpouseInd is the Presidential Election Campaign Fund indicator for the spouse.

digital_assets.rationale: VirtualCurAcquiredDurTYInd corresponds to the digital assets question about receiving/selling/exchanging virtual currency during the tax year.

taxpayer_age_65_or_older.rationale: Primary65OrOlderInd directly maps to the checkbox indicating the primary taxpayer was 65 or older.

taxpayer_blind.rationale: PrimaryBlindInd directly maps to the 'You are blind' checkbox for the primary taxpayer.

spouse_age_65_or_older.rationale: Spouse65OrOlderInd directly maps to the checkbox indicating the spouse was 65 or older.

spouse_blind.rationale: SpouseBlindInd directly maps to the 'Spouse is blind' checkbox.

someone_can_claim_taxpayer_as_dependent.rationale: PrimaryClaimAsDependentInd maps to the checkbox indicating someone can claim the primary taxpayer as a dependent.

someone_can_claim_spouse_as_dependent.rationale: SpouseClaimAsDependentInd maps to the checkbox indicating someone can claim the spouse as a dependent.

spouse_itemizes_on_separate_return.rationale: MustItemizeInd corresponds to the checkbox for 'Spouse itemizes on a separate return or you were a dual-status alien'.

more_than_four_dependents.rationale: MoreDependentsInd directly maps to the checkbox indicating more than four dependents are attached.

dependents.rationale: DependentDetail is the repeating group element containing all dependent sub-fields; the blueprint models dependents as an array which aligns with this repeating group structure.

wages_salaries_tips.rationale: WagesSalariesAndTipsAmt maps to Line 1a total wages, salaries, and tips from W-2 Box 1.

household_employee_wages.rationale: HouseholdEmployeeWagesAmt maps to Line 1b household employee wages not reported on a W-2.

tip_income_not_on_w2.rationale: TipIncomeAmt maps to Line 1c tip income not reported to an employer.

medicaid_waiver_payments.rationale: MedicaidWaiverPymtNotRptW2Amt maps to Line 1d Medicaid waiver payments not reported on a W-2.

taxable_dependent_care_benefits.rationale: No candidate element for Line 1e taxable dependent care benefits from Form 2441 exists in the supplied list.

employer_adoption_benefits.rationale: TaxableBenefitsForm8839Amt maps to Line 1f employer-provided adoption benefits from Form 8839.

wages_from_form_8919.rationale: TotalWagesWithNoWithholdingAmt maps to Line 1g wages from Form 8919 for uncollected Social Security and Medicare tax.

other_earned_income.rationale: OtherEarnedIncomeAmt maps to Line 1h other earned income not captured in prior lines.

total_wages.rationale: WagesAmt maps to Line 1z total wages sum of all line 1 sub-items.

tax_exempt_interest.rationale: TaxExemptInterestAmt directly maps to Line 2a tax-exempt interest income.

taxable_interest.rationale: TaxableInterestAmt directly maps to Line 2b taxable interest income.

qualified_dividends.rationale: QualifiedDividendsAmt directly maps to Line 3a qualified dividends.

ordinary_dividends.rationale: OrdinaryDividendsAmt directly maps to Line 3b total ordinary dividends.

ira_distributions_total.rationale: IRADistributionsAmt maps to Line 4a total IRA distributions (gross amount).

ira_distributions_taxable.rationale: TaxableIRAAmt maps to Line 4b taxable portion of IRA distributions.

pensions_annuities_total.rationale: PensionsAnnuitiesAmt maps to Line 5a total pensions and annuities (gross amount).

pensions_annuities_taxable.rationale: TotalTaxablePensionsAmt maps to Line 5b taxable portion of pensions and annuities.

social_security_total.rationale: SocSecBnftAmt maps to Line 6a total Social Security benefits received.

social_security_taxable.rationale: TaxableSocSecAmt maps to Line 6b taxable portion of Social Security benefits.

lump_sum_election.rationale: LumpSumElectionMethodInd maps to the Line 6c checkbox for using the lump-sum election method.

capital_gain_or_loss.rationale: CapitalGainLossAmt maps to Line 7 net capital gain or loss.

schedule_d_not_required.rationale: CapitalDistributionInd maps to the checkbox on Line 7 indicating Schedule D is not required.

additional_income_schedule1.rationale: TotalAdditionalIncomeAmt maps to Line 8 additional income from Schedule 1, Part I.

total_income.rationale: TotalIncomeAmt maps to Line 9 total income before adjustments.

adjustments_to_income.rationale: TotalAdjustmentsAmt maps to Line 10 adjustments to income from Schedule 1, Part II.

adjusted_gross_income.rationale: AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt directly maps to Line 11 Adjusted Gross Income.

standard_or_itemized_deduction.rationale: TotalItemizedOrStandardDedAmt maps to Line 12 standard or itemized deduction amount.

itemized_deductions_used.rationale: No explicit boolean indicator for itemized vs. standard deduction election appears in the candidate list; this flag is inferred from context rather than stored as a dedicated element.

qbi_deduction.rationale: QualifiedBusinessIncomeDedAmt maps to Line 13 Qualified Business Income deduction.

total_deductions.rationale: TotalDeductionsAmt maps to Line 14 total deductions (standard/itemized plus QBI).

taxable_income.rationale: TaxableIncomeAmt directly maps to Line 15 taxable income.

tax.rationale: TaxAmt maps to Line 16 tax computed on taxable income.

alternative_minimum_tax.rationale: No AlternativeMinimumTaxAmt candidate appears in the supplied list for Line 17 AMT.

excess_advance_premium_tax_credit.rationale: No ExcessAdvancePremiumTaxCreditAmt candidate appears in the supplied list for the excess APTC repayment line.

schedule2_additional_tax.rationale: TotalTaxBeforeCrAndOthTaxesAmt maps to the sum of tax lines (including Schedule 2 additions) before credits, corresponding to the line 18 total in recent revisions.

child_tax_credit_or_credit_for_other_dep.rationale: CTCODCAmt maps to Line 19 Child Tax Credit and/or Credit for Other Dependents from Schedule 8812.

schedule3_credits.rationale: No Schedule3NonrefundableCreditsAmt candidate appears in the supplied list for Line 20 nonrefundable credits from Schedule 3.

total_credits.rationale: TotalNonrefundableCreditsAmt maps to Line 21 total nonrefundable credits.

tax_after_credits.rationale: TaxLessCreditsAmt maps to Line 22 tax after nonrefundable credits.

other_taxes.rationale: TotalOtherTaxesAmt maps to Line 23 other taxes from Schedule 2, Part II.

total_tax.rationale: TotalTaxAmt maps to Line 24 total tax liability.

federal_tax_withheld_w2.rationale: FormW2WithheldTaxAmt maps to Line 25a federal income tax withheld from W-2 forms.

federal_tax_withheld_1099.rationale: Form1099WithheldTaxAmt maps to Line 25b federal income tax withheld from 1099 forms.

federal_tax_withheld_other.rationale: TaxWithheldOtherAmt maps to Line 25c federal income tax withheld from other forms.

total_federal_tax_withheld.rationale: WithholdingTaxAmt maps to Line 25d total federal income tax withheld.

estimated_tax_payments.rationale: EstimatedTaxPaymentsAmt maps to Line 26 estimated tax payments and any prior-year overpayment applied.

earned_income_credit.rationale: EarnedIncomeCreditAmt maps to Line 27 Earned Income Credit.

additional_child_tax_credit.rationale: AdditionalChildTaxCreditAmt maps to Line 28 Additional Child Tax Credit (refundable portion).

american_opportunity_credit.rationale: RefundableAmerOppCreditAmt maps to Line 29 American Opportunity Credit refundable portion.

reserved_line30.rationale: No candidate element for Line 30 (Recovery Rebate Credit or reserved line) appears in the supplied list.

schedule3_refundable_credits.rationale: RefundableCreditsAmt maps to Line 31 refundable credits from Schedule 3.

total_other_payments_refundable_credits.rationale: TotalOtherPaymentsRfdblCrAmt maps to Line 32 total of other payments and refundable credits.

total_payments.rationale: TotalPaymentsAmt maps to Line 33 total payments.

overpaid_amount.rationale: OverpaidAmt maps to Line 34 amount overpaid.

refund_amount.rationale: RefundAmt maps to Line 35a amount to be refunded.

routing_number.rationale: RoutingTransitNum maps to Line 35b bank routing number for direct deposit.

account_type.rationale: BankAccountTypeCd maps to Line 35c type of bank account (checking or savings).

account_number.rationale: DepositorAccountNum maps to Line 35d bank account number for direct deposit.

applied_to_next_year.rationale: AppliedToEsTaxAmt maps to Line 36 overpayment applied to next year's estimated tax.

amount_owed.rationale: OwedAmt maps to Line 37 amount the taxpayer owes.

estimated_tax_penalty.rationale: EsPenaltyAmt maps to Line 38 estimated tax underpayment penalty.

third_party_designee.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneeInd maps to the Yes checkbox in the Third Party Designee section.

third_party_designee_name.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneeNm maps to the name of the third-party designee.

third_party_designee_phone.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneePhoneNum maps to the designee's phone number.

third_party_designee_pin.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneePIN maps to the designee's chosen PIN.

taxpayer_occupation.rationale: PrimaryOccupationTxt maps to the primary taxpayer's occupation field in the signature section.

taxpayer_identity_protection_pin.rationale: No IP PIN element for the primary taxpayer appears in the supplied candidate list.

spouse_occupation.rationale: SpouseOccupationTxt maps to the spouse's occupation field in the signature section.

spouse_identity_protection_pin.rationale: No IP PIN element for the spouse appears in the supplied candidate list.

phone_number.rationale: Taxpayer daytime phone number is not represented in the supplied candidate list.

paid_preparer_name.rationale: Paid preparer name is stored under a Preparer group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_ptin.rationale: Preparer PTIN is stored under a Preparer group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_self_employed.rationale: Preparer self-employed indicator is stored under a Preparer group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_date.rationale: Preparer signature date is stored under a Preparer group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_firm_name.rationale: Preparer firm name is stored under a Preparer/Firm group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_firm_ein.rationale: Preparer firm EIN is stored under a Preparer/Firm group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_firm_address.rationale: Preparer firm address is stored under a Preparer/Firm address group element not present in this candidate list.

paid_preparer_firm_phone.rationale: Preparer firm phone is stored under a Preparer/Firm group element not present in this candidate list.
